paper_title: MADLLM Multivariate Anomaly Detection via Pre-trained LLMs
caption: : F1 score results
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the F1 scores (in percentage) achieved by three variants of the MADLLM model across five different datasets: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, and MSL. The vertical axis represents the F1 Score (%) with a linear scale ranging from 80 to 100, marked at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis lists the five datasets in the order presented. For each dataset, three grouped bars are displayed, corresponding to: MADLLM (light green), MADLLM without feature embedding (purple), and MADLLM without skip embedding (light orange), as indicated in the legend above the chart. In all datasets, the standard MADLLM model (light green) achieves the highest F1 score, consistently outperforming the two ablated versions. The MADLLM w/o feature embedding (purple) generally performs better than MADLLM w/o skip embedding (light orange). For example, on the PSM dataset, MADLLM reaches approximately 98%, while the other two variants achieve around 94% and 92%, respectively. On the SWaT dataset, MADLLM scores about 92%, compared to roughly 86% and 85% for the ablated models. The bars are arranged in groups per dataset, with no explicit sorting of the datasets by performance, and no visual emphasis such as outlines or annotations is applied to any bar.
